title: Rover
safeHtml:
Rover is an important river in Los Sengas. It cuts across Los Sengas Continent, Odyssey and Rover Peninsula.

Contents

  • 1 Location
  • 2 Bridges
  • 3 Tunnels
  • 4 Nearby Districts
  • 5 Channels
  • 6 Citations and References

Location[]

Rover is located to the north of Rover Down, the south of Rover Peninsula and the east of Odyssey. It also passes West Metropolis Archipelago, Peckern Continent and Ingress.

Station Souvenir Hints[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.
  • Stars: 0
  • Find the Los Sengas Coffee of this station.
  • The Station Souvenir comes in the form of a bucket.

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is the first Checkpoint ever built in Los Sengas Division and Nazca Railway as a whole.[2]
  • This station already had all the station facilities upon construction. Therefore, when Upgrading Works took place at this station, only the Departure Routines of the 8 platforms had to be updated.
  • At the time of this station's construction, checkpoint refers to stations which serve as the transport hub at the edge of its respective district, and therefore featured new station facilities, such as Los Sengas Coffee, advertisement boards and Station Art. However, not all the new facilities would be adopted in later stations and Upgrading Works of the Season 1 Stations.
  • The station art at the center of the station depicts the four seasons, namely Spring (Northeast), Summer (Southeast), Fall (Southwest) and Winter (Northwest). While Spring Point, Summer Point , Fall Point and Winter Point gateways would go on to be situated at the southeast, southwest, northwest and northeast respectively, this may have been the inspiration for the setting up of Group 2 Gateways. Coincidentially, the Station Icon of this Station also incorporates elements of the station icons from the four Group 2 Gateways.
  • The design of this station pays tribute to Terracept Terminal.
  • This station is the permanent Down Direction terminus of Golf Line, with a set of Turn Back Sidings to the east of this station.
  • The Golf Line Platforms of this station have been sealed off for four years and eleven months before Golf Line was established.[3]
  • This station is the first station to feature two Station Control Rooms, and was the only station with such a layout at the time of its construction.

History[]

  • August 8 2015: This station began services alongside Urban Line and Luxter Line. Urban Line and Luxter Line extends from Desert Field Station and North Mountain Station to this station respectively. Platforms 5 and 6 were sealed off from public access.
  • August 10 2015: Urban Express is established. Platforms 2, 3 begun services.
  • June 18 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[4]
  • June 9 2018: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[5]
  • July 22 2020: The Urban Line section of this station completed Second Phase IoM Sign Replacement Works.[6]
  • July 31 2020: Golf Line is established. Platforms 5, 6 begun services.
  • January 6 2021: The Luxter Line section of this station completed Second Phase IoM Sign Replacement Works.[7]
  • March 11 2023: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[8]
  • June 27 2026: This Station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[9]

Description []

Rover Line is one of the District lines of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division. It start at the Winsol District and proceeds westwards from Ingress, Glacier and Rover Districts to Odyssey.

This route is represented by Turquiose Green on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and is Line Number 29.

Currently, this route is 22.02 km long, with a total of 13 stations.

  • Winsol
  • Ingress
  • Glacier
  • Rover
  • Odyssey

Station Title and Soundtrack[]

  • The Station Title of this Station is Aqueous Keep.
  • This Station features two soundtracks that belong to the album "From Abyss to Aether".
Name of the Soundtrack Length (mm:ss)
Aqueous Keep 02:48
Currents of Valor 02:04

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is the first station to be built in 2025.
  • Both the Exit A and the Concourse of this station adopt a crowd control pattern to facilitate passenger flow to and from the Rover Stadium Nearby. Passengers using Exit A must keep to the right. Moreover, the set of Stairs and Elevators to the north are used for passengers entering the station, whereas the set of Stairs and Elevators to the south are used for passengers leaving the station.

History[]

  • January 4 2025: This Station began construction.
  • January 6 2025: This Station completed construction.
  • January 7 2025: This Station began services alongside Rover Line, but Pegasus Line Platforms remain reserved. Rover Line is established.
  • April 12 2025: This Station completed setting up of Pegasus Line systems.[2]
  • May 26 2025: Pegasus Line extends from Peacean Island Station to this station through Rover Central Station.

Fun Facts[]

  • The structure of this station pays tribute to Terracept Division Taiiin Hill Station.
  • This station, alongside Causeway Bay Station and Qoser Coast Station, is one of the "anchor points" for Glacier Line climbing to Elevated level from the south. As a result, Side Platforms are used for this station.
  • This station, alongside Qoser Coast Station and Virtue Plateau Station, are built in tribute to Nabela Qoser, a former Hong Kong-based journalist and broadcaster.
  • The section between Qoser Coast Station and Virtue Plateau Station adopts a "Bridge Core" design similar to that of Oasis Bay Line.

History[]

  • October 20 2020: This station began services.

Station Souvenir Hints[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.
  • Stars: 1
  • Scale the Saber Tower.
  • The Station Souvenir comes in the form of a Diamond Sword

Fun Facts[]

  • A Saber Tower is built outside this station, fitting the station name in a fashion similar to Landing Pole Station.
  • The Chairs at the platform of this station have Diamond Swords on it as decoration.
  • Prior to the Coopol Line Expansion, the Los Sengas Coffee of this Station was located at the East Ring Line Concourse. However. it has since been relocated to the Coopol Line Concourse.
  • A memorial that highlights all the stations of Phase 1 Coopol Line Development is placed at the Coopol Line Concourse of this Station near the Los Sengas Coffee. It is also revealed that Phase 1 of Coopol Line Development is named Veil, marking the first instance in Nazca Railway in which a Phase of the Developemnt of any line is given a formal name. It is also revealed that the next two phases will be named Forst and Wraith.

History[]

  • December 22 2016: The platforms of this station completed construction.[3]
  • December 23 2016: This station completed construction.[4]
  • December 24 2016: This station began services alongside East Ring Line.
  • August 29 2025: This station began expansion of the Coopol Line Part.
  • August 31 2025: This station completed expansion of the Coopol Line Part. At the same day, Coopol Line extends from Peaceful Steps Station to this station.

History[]

  • May 27 2022: This station completed construction.[2]
  • May 28 2022: This station began services alongside Pegasus Line, but Origin Line Platforms remain reserved.
  • July 14 2022: Due to the construction of this station, the Origin Line Station Numbers between Kamelen Station and Sand Martin Checkpoint changed.[3]
  • July 17 2022: The Origin Line Part of this station began services. Origin Line trains began stopping at this station.

Fun Facts[]

  • This Station is named after the three villages that are surrounded by the Naturally Generated Villages. Interestingly, all the three villages are named after the surrounding facilities instead of this station.
    • "Luk Tsz Tsuen" to the west is named after the Ractrack to the west of this Station.
    • "Pung Loi Tsuen" to the north is named after Element Hub Transit Evillow Line Sternendach Station.
    • "Qin Wang Tsuen" to the east is named after another Nazca Railway Station, namely Oasis Bay Line, Daybreaker Line Mount Qin West Station.
  • This Station is the first station in which the Los Sengas Coffee features a Station Theme Coffee. The Station Theme Coffee of this Station is "Trinodo".

Samui Line is one of the lines constructed in Period 6 of Los Sengas Railway Cooperation Scheme. It is operated by Mushroom Transit and its construction is complete.

Districts Served[]

  • Ingress
  • Egress Continent

Line Characteristics[]

  • This line adopts the right-hand traffic rule, one of the few instances in Los Sengas.
  • Three Line Island is an Oceanfloor Station, one of the rare instances for a Co-Op Railway Station.

Fun Facts[]

  • This line has plans to extend from both directions in the future.
  • This line was originally operated by Frosview Railway. However, due to historical reasons, operations of this line is handed over to Mushroom Transit.

Station Title and Soundtrack[]

  • The Station Title of this Station is Refined Renown.
  • This Station features two soundtracks that belong to the album "Gleams Between the Rails".
Name of the Soundtrack Length (mm:ss)
Refined Renown 01:30
Dusk of Laurels 01:55

Fun Facts[]

  • Much like Kaling Channel Station before it, this station was not in the initial plans of Season 1, Episode 18. However, it was built to provide a transport connection to the nearby San Annis Stadium.
  • Despite being an elevated station, this station is completely enclosed on all sides and appear as though it is underground. Not only is this station located completely beneath Route 2, the station, as well as the connecting tracks at both sides of this station, are completely covered by sound barriers. As a result, sicne the construction of this station, players, as well as the Railway founder, being to refer Arcgo Line as "The Line with the Enclosed Curse".

History[]

  • December 17 2015: This station began services.
  • September 23 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[3]
  • July 27 2018: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[4]
  • March 6 2024: The Station Title Banner and Station Icons of this station are added.
  • August 7 2024: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[5]

San-Beam Highway, also known as San-Beam Bridge, is one of the unnumbered Routes in Los Sengas. It runs within West Metropolis Archipelago, between Sanfo Island and Beam Island. The Sanfo Island section is built by the owner of Sanfo Island, whereas the Beam Island section is built by the HAMGOSASHI Conglomerate.

Contents

  • 2 Districts Served

San-loop Station is a station on Stadow Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located between Sanfo Island to the east, and Watloop Island to the west. Passengers may also use this station to change to SLT Line 510L (Sanfo Farms Stop) at Sanfo Island and Watloop Island Light Railway Taipa-loop Line (San-loop Station) at Watloop Island.

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is the first existing station in West Metropolis Archipelago, as well as the first in Nazca Railway, to serve two islands at the same time.[3]
  • This station is a dual-colored station, with light blue wool representing Watloop Island and green concrete representing Sanfo Island. It should also be noticed that light blue wool faces the west of the station and green concrete facing the east of the station. The color scheme of this station is determined based on observations from the styles of the islands.[4]
  • Similar to Peanut Island Station, the concourse of this station is also built beneath the platforms.

History[]

  • September 9 2019: This Station began services.

Fun Facts[]

  • The Name of this station alludes to Sand Martin Bridge in Hong Kong, which in turn pays tribute to the first baseball team from Hong Kong to win a league.[2]
  • The original Station Number of Origin Line for this station is 13-07, but due to the completion of Samenta Station, it is modified to 13-08.
  • This station is one of the three planned "super-checkpoints" of Nazca Railway in Season 3, with the first being Tat Stone Hill Checkpoint (Later split into two alongside Europa Checkpoint), and while the third was not explicitly mentioned, it was implied to be Winter Point Gateway.
  • While Sand Martin Village was a naturally generated village near the vicinity of this station, it has been rebuilt and modified to become a landmark featuring the signs from the three planned "super-checkpoints".

Future Development[]

  • Luxter Line, Origin Line and Fox Line will extend from this station to Daisy Island Checkpoint.
  • Once Juliett Line is established, Alpha Line will regress back to Zootuary Station, and Juliett Line will take over the Alpha Line Platforms of this station.
  • ARIES Line will extend from Metropolis Terminal to this station before proceeding to the Los Sengas International and Intergalactic Transport Hub, colloquially known as the SITH.

History[]

  • November 1 2019: This Station is under construction.[3]
  • November 5 2019: This Station began services alongside Alpha Line, but Luxter Line, Origin Line, Abyss Line, Egress Line and Fox Line Platforms remain reserved.
  • November 6 2019: Luxter Line extends from Shore Tip Station to this station.
  • November 9 2019: Abyss Line extends from Kong Corner Station to Shore Tip Station through Twin Cliffs Station and this station.
  • March 3 2020: Origin Line and Egress Line extends from Banyan Station to this station.
  • March 4 2020: Fox Line extends from Flask North Station to this station.
  • January 6 2021: The Luxter Line section of this station completed Second Phase IoM Sign Replacement Works.[4]
  • July 14 2022: Due to the completion of Samenta Station, the Origin Line station number has changed from 13-07 to 13-08.[5]

Nazca Railway 2020 Day Event Souvenir Hints[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.
  • Stars: 1
  • Q: When was Nazca Railway established
  • A: 11/17/2011 (MM/DD/YYYY)
  • A Door Opening Sound indicates that you have answered correctly.
  • The 2020 Day Event Souvenir comes in the form of a Minecart.

Fun Facts[]

  • This station alludes to Tai Shui Hang Station of the MTR in Hong Kong.[2] However, while Tai Shui Hang Station also uses the Green Color, the Green Color from this station was not due to Tai Shui Hang Station. Instead, it was due to Route 2.
  • Similar to Tai Shui Hang Station, the Entry Gate Area of this station is in the west, and all exits of this station are connected by a single tunnel.
  • Although this station is close to SLT Line 201 (The Three Pass Hospital Road Stop), there are no connecting pathways between them.
  • Route 2 and The Three Pass Coast Road had undergone diversion works due to the construction of this station.
  • During the initial planning phase of Sava Line, this station was separated into Sand-O Station and Pass Bay Station. However, these two stations were merged into one station during construction stage, hence the current name of this station.[3]
  • This station is one of the two stations chosen for the 2020 Day Event due to the fact that this station is the 20th Station built in Season 2, making the Station Numeric Code of this Station 02020, with the other station chosen being Peanut Island Station due to it beginning construction on May 15.
  • The Platforms in this station were originally 152m long, but have since been extended to 204m long in anticipation for future development in Odyssey.
  • After the Platform Extension, the west end of Platform 2 in this station is Curved.

History[]

  • July 20 2016: This Station began services.
  • October 9 2017: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[4]
  • February 1 2024: The Platforms of this station have extended from 152m to 204m.
  • March 20 2025: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[5]

Sandcave Station is a station on Grassforest Line. It is operated by Grensis Light Rail Transit, and is located at Los Sengas Grensis Island. Passengers may also use this station to change to Peckern Transit Northland Line (Grensis Island Station).

Fun Facts[]

  • This Station features a memorial that commemorates the completion of Grensis Light Rail Transit.
  • The Concourse of this station provides access to the remains of North Tower Station in the now-defunct Grensis Island Metro, which served as the main transportation mode within Grensis Island prior to its regeneration in mid-2022. It should also be noted that the defunct metro has not been completely demolished despite the island regeneration.

Sanfo Island is one of the islands on West Metropolis Archipelago. On July 18 2016, it also became the third island to complete development in West Metropolis Archipelago.

Contents

  • 2 Location
  • 3 Transport
    • 3.1 Nazca Railway

    • 3.6 Commercial Buildings
    • 3.7 Public Facilities
  • 4 Citations and References

History[]

Originally, Sanfo Island had mountainous terrain. In order to facilitate urban development, all the mountains on this island were razed down, and the shoreline has also undergone reclamation in order to straighten the coast.

Location[]

Sanfo Island is located in the middle of West Metropolis Archipelago to the south of Beam Island.
